blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Energy (DOE) has been scolded by House lawmakers after the agency failed to provide a concrete solution to the power woes hounding the Visayas, amid successive days of yellow and red grid alerts. During the hearing of the House committee on energy and the committee on Visayas development on the power issues, Palawan Rep. Jose Alvarez asked whether DOE has an immediate solution to the shortage. However, Alvarez—chair of the energy panel—said that DOE has not presented any. “Wala silang immediate solution,” Alvarez said. “Bakit Red and Yellow? Bakit Mindanao plants ’di makasupply?
